prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (realistic presenters vs animated/social clips vs generative visuals), your budget, how many videos you’ll make, and where the ads will run. Below are top options by use case and why you might pick each.

Top picks (quick summary)
- Synthesia — Best for realistic AI presenters / human avatars and multilingual voiceovers. Great for B2B explainer ads, product demos, and corporate branding.
- HeyGen (Movio/Elai-style competitors) — Good alternative to Synthesia for avatar-driven ads; often faster or cheaper depending on the plan.
- Runway — Best for cutting-edge generative visuals and advanced editing (text-to-video, background replacement, VFX). Use if you want creative, novel visuals.
- Pictory — Best for turning blog posts/long-form content into short social ad clips automatically (good for repurposing).
- InVideo / Lumen5 / Promo / Wave.video — Best for fast template-driven social ads; large template libraries and easy customization.
- Descript — Best if you need transcript-based editing, overdubs, and quick repurposing of existing video/audio into ads.
- Shakr / Smartly.io / VidMob — Best for scale and ad-platform optimization (enterprise-level ad production + testing/variants).
- Canva / Clipchamp — Best for teams that want simple, brand-consistent short ads and lots of templates (very easy for non-editors).

How to pick the best one for you
- Want an on-screen human presenter (AI actor)? Choose Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Need lots of short social ads fast from copy/articles? Pictory, InVideo, Lumen5, or Canva.
- Want cutting-edge generative video or heavy visual effects? Try Runway (or newer text-to-video model platforms).
- Need to edit by editing the transcript and create voice clones? Descript.
- Need enterprise-scale ad creation and automated A/B testing? Look at Shakr, Smartly.io, or VidMob.
- Budget-conscious/DIY and many templates: Canva, InVideo, or Promo.

Other considerations
- Output licensing / commercial rights — check terms for ads.
- Languages and voice options — important for international campaigns.
- API/automation — needed if you want to generate hundreds of videos programmatically.
- Brand control — look for custom templates, fonts, color palettes, and asset libraries.
- File formats & aspect ratios — ensure it exports to the sizes you need (16:9, 1:1, 9:16 for Reels/TikTok).

If you want, tell me:
- Your use case (product demo, social ad, e‑commerce, B2B, explainer)
- Typical ad length and platforms (Facebook/Instagram, YouTube, TikTok)
- Monthly volume and budget
I’ll recommend the top 2–3 tools for your situation and a quick cost/feature comparison.
